description:
Welcome to another "How to make" video, this time it's Ben & Jerry's Salted Caramel Brownie Topped. 

The ice cream base used in this remake was Ben & Jerry's own sweet cream base from their book. It's definately light in texture and creamy but I personally prefer my ice cream a little richer and with more body. Obviously this recipe used raw eggs so make sure you are happy to do that or use pasteurized eggs. You can pasteurize eggs at home if you want too!

Ice Cream Ingredients:

500ml (2 cups) Double (heavy) cream or Whipping Cream if that's whats available
250ml (1 cup) Whole milk
2 Large eggs
150g (3/4 cup) Sugar

Brownies Ingredients:
110g Butter
275g Dark Chocolate
275g Sugar
3 Large Eggs
150g Plain Flour

The Caramel sauce was Jude's which may or may not be available outside the UK. If not, you can use the recipe here:
https://www.livewellbakeoften.com/homemade-salted-caramel-sauce/
This is an excellent and very easy recipe. 

Again, my wife did the tub decoration which is amazing and she has that job from now on ha. 

We hope you enjoy this ice cream and if you do make it, please send us some pictures so we can see them. I will be making a page on our website to show off fans creations soon so stay tuned. 

Thanks and as always, Like & Subscribe and visit our social media accounts linked below.

Instagram: https://tinyurl.com/2p85zcxh
Facebook: http://tiny.cc/mmxosz
Website: https://polaricecreamery.com/


Thanks and see you on the next video :)
Nick @ 5DShake
